And he said. Nay ; but os captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him. What saith my lord unto his servant?

Stood o’er her murder’d sons! She laid her hand Upon their marble foreheads, while the blood Was freely gushing from their purple wounds! And yet she lives, and yet bears witness to The truth for which they fell a sacrifice.
